title: 2019-2020 RAV4 Adventure / Limited AWD: buzz or groan from the front transfer case, program 20TE03
summary: Toyota Customer Support Program 20TE03: an abnormal buzz or groan from the front transfer case in Normal mode as the AWD disconnects (20-30 mph accelerating) or reconnects (20-13 mph slowing), usually after 15+ minutes of driving. Fix is a new electro-magnetic clutch kit, with an AWD ECU reflash if needed; covered 10 years / 125,000 miles.

specs.name: Typically after
specs.value: 15 minutes or more of driving, Normal drive mode

specs.name: Coverage
specs.value: 10 years or 125,000 miles from date of first use, whichever first

specs.name: Repair kit
specs.value: 04000-28142 Repair Kit, Transfer (order the kit, not the parts inside it)

specs.name: Vehicles
specs.value: About 36,900 RAV4s built early March 2018 to late October 2019

steps.text: Confirm the noise in Normal drive mode: buzz or groan from the front transfer case at 20-30 mph accelerating from a stop, and/or 20-13 mph slowing down, usually after 15+ minutes of driving.
If verified, replace the front transfer case electro-magnetic clutch and drain plug using kit 04000-28142, and reprogram the AWD ECU if needed.

body: The repair kit part number was revised on July 13, 2023; the number above is from that revision.
